steam_hammer_2a.title: WORK ORDER — HAMMER IN 2A
steam_hammer_2a.summary: The 2A radiator hammers on every boiler cycle. One-pipe steam: a part-closed supply or a failed air vent traps condensate in the run.

reported.text: Mina Vale reports a banging in the pipes, timed, and she cannot annotate it.

stage_objectives.issued: 2A reports steam hammer on every boiler cycle. Take the job.
stage_objectives.diagnosed: The air vent will not seal and the supply valve is part closed. A replacement vent orifice is needed.
stage_objectives.awaiting_part: Obtain a No. 3 vent orifice from the hardware counter.
stage_objectives.repairable: Fit the vent orifice: supply full open, vent at the far end, check the pitch.
stage_objectives.repaired: The riser is quiet. Tell Mina the hammer is done.
